payload.purpose_context: A work package's lifecycle record under kitty-ops/lifecycle/ could only be closed by spec-kitty next reporting a result, which also advances the Mission, so stale records shipped open (#7346). The operator ruled that the existing stale sweep closes them as abandoned and commits the closures.
payload.purpose_tldr: Let doctor ops --close-stale close orphaned work-package lifecycle records as abandoned without advancing the Mission.

payload.question: Which CLI route closes an orphaned WP lifecycle record without advancing the Mission?

payload.final_answer: extend doctor ops --close-stale (operator triage ruling on #7346, 2026-11-08); no new command

payload.question: How is a sweep closure of a lifecycle record represented?

payload.final_answer: new abandoned phase (operator ruling via AskUserQuestion, 2026-11-10); record contract change with an ADR 2026-11-01-2 amendment

payload.question: Does the sweep commit the lifecycle closures it writes?

payload.final_answer: auto-commit like the Op sweep (operator ruling via AskUserQuestion, 2026-11-10): #6410 skip semantics, protected-branch refusal reported, never bypassed

payload.question: Confirm the Intent Summary for #7346 (sweep scope: every checkout; fresh orphans exit 1 like fresh Ops; abandoned counts as a completion in pairing)?

payload.final_answer: Confirm as written (operator via AskUserQuestion, 2026-11-10): sweep every checkout; fresh lifecycle orphans exit 1 as fresh Ops do; abandoned counts as a completion; additive lifecycle_records JSON key; older CLIs skip abandoned records

payload.wp_title: The lifecycle sweep in doctor ops --close-stale
